name: cmdb_sync_unique
label: Configuration Synchronization Unique Attribute
description: Configuration synchronization with unique attributes can be used for related queries in configuration management and report queries.

fields.name: ci_collection_id
fields.description: Configuration set ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: attr_id
fields.description: Configuration item ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ci_collection_id, attr_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
